name: drape
_note: a hand DRAPED over a rail or a post's top (the squat still: holding a chair's back for balance): the palm on top, the fingers bent at the knuckles and middle joints and curling down over the front, the thumb tucked under out of sight. Used with the pose's fx.fingersIn = 1 (a palm laid down and seen side-on curls its fingers IN the picture; mum3's out-of-plane finger fx only shortened them and the hand hovered past the post like a paddle, round 5) and the hand's width squashed edge-on (pose.scale hand: [1, 0.6]). Picked beside the still with tools/side_zoom.py (lesson 64). Two fists clenched on the crest read as gripping a bar, not resting her balance on it (round 4)
